The competency's verb pair is 'Determine and write the value'; every valuation item in the set is four-option selection, and the two open items ask the pupil to place money on screen rather than to write an amount. Under Rule 8 the fix is a write-the-amount (free-entry) route on this node's valuation items, not a re-attestation — carried to Next tick should:, not built this tick (budget).
